entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this VeloBand Pulse monitor. It's a piece of junk and I want my money back now. I've been trying to do it online and your system is impossible.

I'm very sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your VeloBand. I can certainly look into the return options for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It doesn't matter! It doesn't work right, the battery is a joke, and I just don't want it anymore. I got it over a month ago. Just process the return.

I understand your frustration, sir. I do have to mention, for a wearable device that's been in use, our updated **policy** can be quite strict due to **hygiene** and **sanitation** concerns. Frankly, after this amount of time, it's almost always **too late** for a refund.

Are you kidding me?! 'Too late?' I'm going to write a review on every website I can find and tell them how VeloFit sells garbage and then refuses returns. This is ridiculous! Get me your manager, right now!

Sir, please allow me to double-check everything before we go that route. Let me just pull up your order details with your phone number... one moment... Okay, I see your purchase from December. My apologies, I misspoke. It looks like your purchase is still covered under our 90-day satisfaction guarantee.
Wait... what? So you're saying I can return it?

Yes, absolutely. I was mistaken looking at the wrong guidelines. Your item is well within the 90-day timeframe. I can approve this return for a full refund immediately. I'm generating a prepaid shipping label to send to the email we have on file. Does that work for you?
Oh. Okay, yes. That works. A full refund, you said?

That's correct. A full refund to your original payment method once we receive the item back at our warehouse. The email with the label has just been sent. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
